objective: Replace identity/category/profile shortcuts with inference-driven authored CompositionPlan while preserving accepted reference behavior as regression evidence only.

observed_current_targets.current_role: narrow accepted reference adapter and compatible grammar selection
observed_current_targets.migration: keep fixture/reference data in test/evidence scope; route production through generic AuthoringInput -> CompositionPlanner -> CompositionPlan without reference identity selection

observed_current_targets.current_role: service-category keyword -> visual family/profile/authority/scene shortcut for field validation
observed_current_targets.migration: remove this shortcut from final composition/profile selection; category may remain factual context but must not directly choose CompositionPlan topology/profile
derive rendering form from CompositionPlan scene/topology/media/density/CTA intents; no Family/category/company -> fixed profile

stages.name: freeze_regressions
stages.behavior: Nagi/Regina/uka and accepted Phase C outputs remain immutable regression fixtures/evidence, never runtime routing keys.

stages.name: shadow_plan
stages.behavior: Generate CompositionPlan beside legacy render path; compare decisions, public semantics and traces without changing production output.

stages.name: reference_planner_validation
stages.behavior: Route accepted references through planner using truth/decision/Fit/grammar inputs with identity routing disabled; compare screenshots/traces against accepted intent.

stages.name: generic_planner_primary
stages.behavior: CompositionPlan becomes the only production composition input; renderer consumes plan rather than category/company/reference profile maps.

stages.name: delete_runtime_shortcuts
stages.behavior: Delete/deactivate identity/category-keyed composition routing and add static/behavioral tests forbidding reintroduction.

stages.name: retain_test_fixtures_only
stages.behavior: Reference ids/slugs remain permitted only in tests, artifact paths and audit labels, never in planner selection logic.

compatibility_rule: Migration may preserve lower-level renderer implementations where useful, but their selection must be justified by CompositionPlan intent rather than identity/category/Family lookup.
rollback_rule: If planner output cannot preserve an accepted decision/trust contract, stop and return to research/implementation review; do not silently call the legacy identity/category fallback.
completion_tests: static search finds no runtime company/reference lookup selecting layout/profile
behavioral mutation of company_id/reference_id with identical semantic inputs does not change CompositionPlan
changing decision state with same company identity can change CompositionPlan
same Family + different decision/company truth can produce materially different plan semantics
Production Feasibility changes realization only after Family freeze
